aula.objetivo: Read short Russian texts using strategies (read the title and key sentences, find the source, cause and sequence, work out words from the root and from context) and answer comprehension questions.

blocos.titulo: How to read Russian without fearing new words
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: read the TITLE and the first sentence first: they give the topic. STEP 2: look for the KEY SENTENCES: the subject, the verb and the tense («Анна проснулась», «идёт дождь»). STEP 3: mark the CONNECTORS: «потому что, поэтому, хотя, благодаря» show cause and contrast. STEP 4: identify the SEQUENCE through gerunds and time adverbs: «Выйдя из дома…», «Придя на работу…». STEP 5: for a new word, look at the ROOT and the PREFIX: «учить, учитель, учебник» share «уч-». STEP 6: use the CONTEXT: what makes sense there? STEP 7: do NOT stop at every unknown word: keep going and come back later. STEP 8: after reading, RETELL: who did what, where, when and why. English readers can use the same skills, but in Russian the ROOT is especially helpful, because families of words are built around it.

blocos.enunciado: Say the 6 reading steps out loud and give an example of each with a Russian sentence.
